#@ requires 1 == 1
    #@ ensures 1 == 1
    #@ assigns \nothing
    def collect_escaping_exceptions(stmts: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Set[str]:
        raised: Set[str] = set()
        caught: Set[str] = set()
        n = len(stmts)
        i = 0
        #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n
        #@ loop variant n - i
        while i < n:
            stmt = stmts[i]
            if stmt.get("stmt") == "Raise" and stmt.get("exc_type"):
                raised.add(stmt["exc_type"])
            if stmt.get("stmt") == "Try":
                inner_raised = IRScanner.collect_escaping_exceptions(stmt.get("body", []))
                handlers = stmt.get("handlers", [])
                n_h = len(handlers)
                j = 0
                #@ loop invariant 0 <= j and j <= n_h
                #@ loop variant n_h - j
                while j < n_h:
                    h = handlers[j]
                    exc = h.get("exc_type")
                    if exc:
                        parts = exc.split("|")
                        n_p = len(parts)
                        k = 0
                        #@ loop invariant 0 <= k and k <= n_p
                        #@ loop variant n_p - k
                        while k < n_p:
                            ep = parts[k].strip()
                            if ep:
                                caught.add(ep)
                            k += 1
                    raised |= IRScanner.collect_escaping_exceptions(h.get("body", []))
                    j += 1
                raised |= (inner_raised - caught)
            else:
                keys = ["body", "orelse"]
                n_k = len(keys)
                m = 0
                #@ loop invariant 0 <= m and m <= n_k
                #@ loop variant n_k - m
                while m < n_k:
                    key = keys[m]
                    if key in stmt:
                        raised |= IRScanner.collect_escaping_exceptions(stmt[key])
                    m += 1
            i += 1
        return raised
